india6.title: Kerala CM releases anthology of essays by former civil servants

india6.title: Flash floods hit six districts in Arunachal; one dead, four missing

india6.title: Five arrested, FIR registered in Taratala warehouse accident

india6.title: PACOM, the deeper meaning behind a dropped prefix
india6.description: The U.S.’s reversion from INDOPACOM to PACOM suggests that its regional shifts run deeper than a simple name change

india6.title: Kerala CM proposes inter-State collaboration with Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry to combat drug smuggling
india6.description: V.D. Satheesan writes to his counterparts in Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry to join forces sharing to dismantle criminal enterprises that thrive on drug smuggling through joint enforcement and intelligence

india6.title: People-centric digital services likely to be affected for 24 hours from June 25

india6.title: Fiancee or lover: Who pushed Ketan Agarwal off the cliff
india6.description: Police are examining forensic evidence to determine whether the fatal shove was administered by Siya Goyal or her lover; Mr. Chaudhary’s decision to wear a hoodie on a hot day roused police suspicions

india6.description: The PAC was meeting to deliberate the CAG’s report on the ‘establishment and functioning of Andaman and Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences’

india6.title: Air India plane strays into Pakistan airspace; DGCA takes action against air traffic controller, crew

india6.title: Passport is not a citizenship document: senior MEA official

india6.title: Emergency is the greatest assault on Indian democracy, says Bihar BJP president Sanjay Saraogi

india6.title: State aims at 32% growth in mining sector, says Minister Kollu Ravindra

india6.title: Assault on human dignity, says Rahul Gandhi on incident of bonded labour in U.P.

india6.description: Shia mourners, including women and children, assembled in Srinagar’s Guru Bazar around 6 a.m. and the procession culminated at Dalgate around 9 a.m.

india6.description: How could RTI Rules be amended without prior disclosure and public consultation, ask activists

india7.title: Kolkata warehouse collapse kills five; 15 feared trapped under debris

india7.title: How life insurance plans are evolving into retirement plans for India's middle class

india7.description: TVK leader Vijay's unconventional approach, including large-scale food distribution and fielding candidates from diverse professions, is reshaping Tamil Nadu politics, appealing to youth and challenging established parties.

india7.title: Union Minister George Kurian resigns
india7.description: Union Minister of State George Kurian has resigned, his Rajya Sabha term having ended and the BJP not renominating him. President Murmu accepted the resignation.

india7.title: Lucknow fire: Building owners arrested, coaching centres shut down
india7.description: Following a fatal fire, four Lucknow officials were suspended, and four building owners arrested. Investigations into illegal commercial use of residential property and safety violations by coaching centres are underway across districts.

india7.title: Centre tightens FCRA rules; NGOs must specify purpose, exclude proselytisation

japan1.title: みらい 与野党の議員対象にAI勉強会を開催 安野党首が講師
japan1.description: チームみらいは与野党の国会議員を対象にAIの勉強会を開き、エンジニアの経験を持つ安野党首が活用するメリットや利用上の注意点を解説しました。

japan1.title: 株価 7万2000円台を回復 半導体やAI関連中心に幅広く買い注文
japan1.description: 25日の東京株式市場、日経平均株価は一時、2800円以上値上がりし、7万2000円台を回復しています。

japan1.title: ホンダと日産 次世代車の基幹部品を共通化 開発費を軽減
japan1.description: ホンダと日産自動車が、ソフトウエアの更新で性能をアップデートできる次世代の車「SDV」の開発をめぐり、一部の基幹部品を共通化する方向で協議を進めていることがわかりました。巨額の開発費の負担を軽減するねらいで、2029年以降、両社の車に搭載することを目指すとしています。

japan1.title: NY原油 一時1バレル＝70ドル割れ 3か月半ぶり安値水準
japan1.description: 24日のニューヨーク原油市場では、ホルムズ海峡をめぐる状況が改善し中東からの原油の供給が回復に向かうとの期待感から、国際的な取り引きの指標となるWTIの先物価格はことし3月上旬以来、およそ3か月半ぶりに一時、1バレル＝70ドルを下回りました。

japan1.title: 17戦略分野への投資額 2040年度までに「370兆円超」
japan1.description: 政府の経済財政諮問会議などの合同会議が開かれ、新たな成長戦略の策定に向けて、AI・半導体や造船など17の戦略分野に官民が連携して投資する規模を2040年度までに「総額370兆円を超える」と想定する計画をまとめました。高市総理大臣は予算編成のあり方を見直し、複数年度の計画に基づく「『強く豊かな日本』投資枠」を創設する考えを示しました。

japan1.title: 不正アクセスで情報漏えいのKDDIに報告徴収 総務省
japan1.description: KDDIが取引先の企業に提供しているメールシステムに不正なアクセスがあり、最大1400万件余りのメールアドレスなどが漏えいした可能性があることを受けて、総務省は、会社に詳しい原因や再発防止策などを報告するよう求める行政処分を行いました。

japan1.title: 官民ファンド クールジャパン機構 累積赤字拡大 統廃合検討へ
japan1.description: 政府と民間が共同で出資する官民ファンド「クールジャパン機構」は24日、昨年度までの累積赤字が540億円に拡大したと発表しました。累積赤字の目標を達成できなかったため、政府は統廃合に向けた検討を進め、年内をめどに結論を出すことにしています。

japan1.title: 日産株主総会 再任否決された永井氏の賛成率は48％余
japan1.description: 日産自動車の株主総会で社外取締役への再任が否決されたみずほフィナンシャルグループ出身の永井素夫氏について、賛成率が48％余りだったことがわかりました。大株主のルノーが採決を棄権していて、今後の経営にどのような影響が出てくるかが焦点となります。

japan1.title: 日銀 植田総裁 今後も中東情勢見ながら利上げ検討の姿勢示す
japan1.description: 日銀の植田総裁は24日、金融業界の会合に寄せたあいさつで、今月利上げに踏み切った理由について物価上昇のリスクに対応するためだとした上で、今後も中東情勢などを見極めながら利上げを検討する姿勢を示しました。

japan1.title: 株主総会が今週ピーク 経営の抜本的見直し求める提案も
japan1.description: 上場企業の株主総会は今週がピークです。いわゆる物言う株主から出された議案が過去最多となっているほか、経営トップの解任を求めるなど会社側にとって厳しい内容の議案も相次ぎ、会社側は企業価値を向上させる方法など例年以上に説得力のある説明が求められそうです。

japan1.title: 円相場 1ドル＝161円台 神経質な値動きに
japan1.description: 24日の東京外国為替市場、政府・日銀による市場介入への警戒が続く中で、円相場は1ドル＝161円台半ばから後半での神経質な値動きとなりました。

japan1.title: KADOKAWA株主総会 社長解任求める株主提案は否決
japan1.description: 出版やアニメ制作などを手がけるKADOKAWAは24日に株主総会を開き、投資ファンドが業績の低迷などを理由に社長の解任を求める株主提案を提出しましたが、反対多数で否決されました。

japan1.title: ロート製薬株主総会 物言う株主からの会長解任議案は否決
japan1.description: ロート製薬の株主総会が、24日に大阪市で行われ、アクティビスト＝物言う株主とされる海外の投資ファンドから、創業家出身の会長の解任などを求める議案が提案されましたが、いずれも否決されました。

japan1.title: 株価 利益確定の売り注文で値下がり
japan1.description: 24日の東京株式市場、このところの急ピッチな株価上昇を受けて、当面の利益を確定しようという売り注文が出て、株価は値下がりしました。

japan1.title: メガバンク3行がグーグルの最新AI利用へ 片山金融担当相
japan1.description: 極めて高性能な最新のAIをめぐって、悪用された場合の深刻なリスクが懸念される中、片山金融担当大臣は、アメリカのIT大手、グーグルの最新AIを国内のメガバンク3行が利用できるようになったと明らかにしました。

japan1.title: JDI株主総会 車載向け事業を中心に経営再建の方針説明
japan1.description: 経営再建中の液晶パネルメーカー「ジャパンディスプレイ」の株主総会が開かれ、車載向けの事業を中心に経営の立て直しを図る方針が説明されました。

japan1.title: ソフトバンクG 孫社長 “あと10年か15年は頑張る”
japan1.description: AI関連の投資を進めるソフトバンクグループの孫正義社長は24日の株主総会で「あと10年か15年は頑張る」と述べ、当面は、みずからが経営トップを続け、AI関連の事業に力を入れる考えを示しました。

japan1.title: ガソリン価格 全国平均169.8円 政府補助金で170円水準続く
japan1.description: 国の委託を受けてガソリン価格を調査している石油情報センターによりますと、レギュラーガソリンの小売価格は22日時点の全国平均で1リットル当たり169.8円と、前の週より0.1円値上がりしました。政府の激変緩和措置による補助金で170円程度の水準が続いています。また、25日からの出荷分を対象とした補助金の額は、前の週より12.2円減って1リットル当たり6円になるとしています。

japan1.title: 利上げ決定の日銀会合 追加利上げ早期に検討すべきの意見も
japan1.description: 日銀は利上げを決定した今月の金融政策決定会合での主な意見を公表しました。利上げをめぐる議論では今後の物価高への懸念が相次いで示されていたほか、今後の金融政策をめぐっても早期に追加の利上げを検討すべきだといった意見が複数出ていたことがわかりました。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz 6月24日(水) イラン情勢で進むエネルギー転換
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: ナスダックの株価指数2％超の大幅下落 日韓のハイテク株安波及
japan1.description: 23日のニューヨーク株式市場では、半導体をはじめAI関連の銘柄に売り注文が出て、ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダックの株価指数は2％余りの大幅な下落となりました。日本や韓国でのハイテク株の下落の流れが波及した形です。

japan1.title: サイバー攻撃への新たな対応サービス開発相次ぐ
japan1.description: 企業へのサイバー攻撃の被害が相次ぐ中、IT関連の企業の間では、個人情報の流出を自動で検知し、情報の悪用を防ぐといった新たなサービスを開発する動きが相次いでいます。

japan1.title: 南米とEPA交渉この夏にも開始 農業めぐり厳しい交渉に
japan1.description: 政府は、この夏にも南米の関税同盟「メルコスール」との間で、EPA＝経済連携協定の交渉を始めます。牛肉をはじめとした安価な南米産農産物の輸入が拡大して、国内農業に深刻な影響が及ぶといった懸念の声も強く、厳しい交渉が予想されます。

japan1.title: 円相場 1ドル＝161円台で神経質な取引 介入への警戒続く
japan1.description: 23日の東京外国為替市場、円安の進行を食い止めるための政府・日銀による市場介入への警戒が強まる中、円相場は1ドル＝161円台での神経質な値動きになりました。

japan1.title: 1422万件のアドレスなど流出か KDDIシステムに不正アクセス
japan1.description: KDDIは、取引先の企業に提供しているメールシステムが不正アクセスを受け、利用者のメールアドレスとパスワードが最大で1422万件漏えいした可能性があると発表しました。利用者にパスワードの変更を早急に行うよう呼びかけています。

japan1.title: 東京23区中古マンション 平均1億2800万円余 賃貸の家賃も上昇
japan1.description: 先月、東京23区で販売された中古マンションの平均価格は、70平方メートルに換算して1億2800万円あまりとなり、去年の同じ月と比べておよそ27％上昇しました。日銀が今月、利上げに踏み切ったことで、住宅需要にどのような影響が出るかが焦点です。

japan1.title: 日産株主総会 みずほFG出身の社外取締役の再任を否決
japan1.description: 経営再建中の日産自動車の株主総会が開かれ、会社側が提出した取締役12人の選任案のうち、みずほフィナンシャルグループ出身の社外取締役、永井素夫氏の再任が否決されました。大手企業の会社側の提案が否決されるのは異例で、今後の経営への影響が懸念されます。

japan1.title: YKKが「買いたたき」 再発防止などを求める勧告 公取委
japan1.description: ファスナーで世界的なシェアを持つ「YKK」が、製品の加工や検査を委託する事業者に、不当に低い単価で作業をさせる「買いたたき」をしたとして、公正取引委員会は、再発防止などを求める勧告を出しました。

japan1.title: 塗料用シンナーの直接販売 きょうから注文受け付け始まる
japan1.description: 塗料用シンナーの流通の目詰まりを解消するとして、経済産業省は、メーカーから工務店などに直接販売する仕組みを整備し、23日から注文の受け付けを始めました。

japan1.title: 株価 2500円超下落で7万円割れ 利益確保の売り膨らむ
japan1.description: 23日の東京株式市場、このところの株価の急ピッチな上昇を警戒していったん利益を確定させようという売り注文が膨らみ、日経平均株価は2500円を超える大幅な下落となり、7万円を割り込みました。

japan2.description: The issue emerged when an outlet published that one of Takaichi's secretaries met with an individual who participated in a smear campaign against rival candidates.

japan2.title: Thai stock market thriving as surprise beneficiary of AI boom
japan2.description: While the country lacks the semiconductor champions of Taiwan or South Korea, investors are increasingly recognizing its role in supplying the infrastructure behind AI.

japan2.title: Carlo Ancelotti praises Vinicius Junior as Brazil tops Scotland to win Group C
japan2.description: Vinicius scored twice, including a header, in the first half in Miami to set Brazil on the way to a victory which allowed it to progress to the last 32 as winner of Group C.

japan2.title: Police investigate possible link between laundry and school fire
japan2.description: In addition to a burnt electric heater and multiple air circulators, a power strip with multiple outlets was found at the scene.

japan2.title: Sweden coach Graham Potter says team has to defend better against Japan
japan2.description: The Swedes followed up their opening 5-1 win over Tunisia with a loss by the same scoreline against the Netherlands and are third in Group F.

japan2.title: Chinese tourists flock to New Zealand under visa-waiver trial
japan2.description: China was New Zealand's second-largest source of tourists before the COVID-19 pandemic, but it has yet to return to those levels.

japan2.title: Australia’s social media ban for under 16s having little impact, study shows
japan2.description: Underage users have been dodging the restrictions by using accounts registered to older people, setting up fake accounts, or by logging into private browsers.

japan2.title: Hong Kong arrests two for allegedly selling ‘seditious’ material
japan2.description: Local outlets reported one of the items being sold was a biography of jailed media mogul Jimmy Lai.

japan2.title: Teen in Nashville cheers for Japan at World Cup while dreaming of joining women’s squad
japan2.description: As the Japan Football Association evaluated her skills, Wakatsuki was able to make her national team debut with the U-16 squad at a tournament in France in April last year.

japan2.title: Japanese railway firms adopt AI safety systems at crossings
japan2.description: The technology can automatically detect and report abnormalities, such as stalled vehicles or people trapped on the tracks.

japan2.title: Spotlight shines on Aryna Sabalenka’s mental struggles ahead of Wimbledon
japan2.description: Gustavo Granitto, an International Tennis ⁠Federation coach, said Sabalenka's competitive ​drive sometimes blurred her decision-making.

japan2.title: Australia’s spy chief warns of rising terror and cyber threats
japan2.description: Mike Burgess, head of the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation, has identified extremism and foreign espionage as among the threats his agency is trying to prevent.

japan2.title: Interim draft on two-year food tax cut presented
japan2.description: The proposal calls for reducing the tax rate to 1% for food for two years from April 2027.

japan2.title: ‘Unacceptable’: Laser pointer aimed at Punch, the viral baby monkey
japan2.description: Pointing a laser at a monkey will cause it a great amount of stress, a zoo official said, adding that aiming one at its eyes could cause blindness.

japan2.title: Global Ebola risk ‘remains low,’ WHO chief says after France case
japan2.description: France announced its first confirmed case of Ebola identified on its territory: a doctor who had flown back from the Congo.

japan2.title: Health ministry worker indicted for stalking subordinate
japan2.description: According to the prosecution, the health ministry worker repeatedly messaged his subordinate, secretly photographed her and entered her home without permission.

japan2.title: Buildings collapse as quakes rock Venezuela, ‘high casualties’ likely
japan2.description: A magnitude 7.2 earthquake has hit about 160 km west of Caracas, followed less than a minute later by a ​magnitude 7.5 tremor, according to the U.S. Geological Survey.

japan2.title: First global rules adopted for self-driving cars, U.N. says
japan2.description: Safety concerns and the cost of developing next-level systems have long slowed progress on autonomous vehicles.

japan2.title: Japan’s LNG stocks seen to benefit from Middle East supply risk
japan2.description: The country's firms are an indispensable part of every stage in the LNG supply chain, which includes plant contractors and turbine suppliers.

japan2.title: Trump asks U.S. Congress for more funds to fight Iran, defying rebuke on war powers
japan2.description: The supplemental funding request ​includes $67.15 billion for the military, in addition to some $1 trillion appropriated last year and the $1.5 trillion Trump wants for next ‌year.

japan2.title: Toyota threatens GM’s sales crown as U.S. hybrid demand surges
japan2.description: Japanese automaker Toyota overtaking General Motors in sales in the Detroit automaker's home market would mark a historic shift.

japan2.title: Magnitude 6.9 quake hits northern Japan
japan2.description: No tsunami warning has been issued over the temblor, which registered a rare upper 6 on the Japanese seismic intensity scale in the town of Hashikami, Aomori Prefecture.

japan2.title: More records fall as Europe’s deadly heat wave persists
japan2.description: A scientific study published this week said the current heat wave was "significantly exacerbated by human-induced climate change."

japan2.title: NATO’s Rutte makes hard sell to Trump to ease Iran war strains
japan2.description: Trump appeared mostly unmoved, though he gave no indication that he's preparing to downgrade relations with the alliance.

japan2.title: Trump and Republicans clash after president scraps housing bill signing
japan2.description: Lawmakers pressed Trump over his handling of the war in Iran.

japan2.title: Keiko Fujimori: Peru’s biggest political loser poised to win election
japan2.description: With almost all the ballots counted, Fujimori held 50.12% of the vote, a margin of just over 43,000 over her leftist rival Roberto Sanchez, according to electoral authorities.

japan2.title: Japan unveils $2.3 trillion investment plan for next 14 years
japan2.description: The roadmap marks a key step in Takaichi's effort to put her stamp on Japan's growth strategy as technological change and geopolitical tensions reshape economic priorities.

japan2.title: Schools in Tokyo suburb to get bear sprays

ca3.description: Canada’s men lost to Switzerland 2-1 in a sweltering B.C. Place on Wednesday afternoon, ending their hopes of continuing their historic World Cup campaign at home.

ca3.title: Halifax-bound Air Canada flight diverted to Boston after captain experiences medical issue
ca3.description: AC7664 was enroute from Newark to Halifax on Wednesday afternoon. The captain experienced a medical issue during the flight and it was diverted to Boston. Air Canada says it is working to help its 61 customers who were on the plane make new travel arrangements.

ca3.title: Alberta separation could prompt potential $62B economic hit, business exodus: Calgary Chamber report
Toronto saw significant increase in speeders after camera removals: city report
ca3.description: In a new report Mayor Olivia Chow describes as "horrifying," Toronto transportation staff say there has been a significant increase in speeding where cameras used to be located in the city.

ca3.title: La Ronge, Sask., sees record number of high school graduates
ca3.description: The principals of La Ronge's two high school say a block system, a success coach, a caring environment and extra help with assignment are some of the factors that led to an increase in students graduating Grade 12 this year.

ca3.title: You asked, we answer: Canada's new social media rules for kids
ca3.description: The federal government is moving to restrict social media access for Canadians under the age of 16. Parents, educators and experts have differing opinions on the Safe Social Media Act — and plenty of questions about the details. So you asked, and we answered.

ca3.title: Meet the Calgarian behind Team Canada's World Cup 2026 jerseys
ca3.description: Team Canada's 2026 kit has been in the works since the last World Cup four years ago — and it's the brain child of a Calgarian. As the lead designer at Nike for the national team's latest kit, Calgary-based Holly Gallacher was behind the designs of the national team's home and away jerseys.

ca3.title: The B.C. heat dome had a deadly impact on New Westminster. 5 years later, cooling is top of mind
ca3.description: Five years after extreme heat killed 33 people in New Westminster, the city has built out a network of cooling stations and passed bylaws aimed at cooling apartments.

ca3.title: Toronto gang war led police to a trove of evidence in Ryan Wedding cocaine case, court docs say
ca3.description: More than two years after the arrest of alleged hitman Malik Damion Cunningham in a Toronto suburb, new details about the circumstances of the police operation have emerged from unsealed warrant documents. Cunningham was purportedly hired, armed and trained by Ryan Wedding’s alleged drug ring.

ca3.title: Carney announcing decision on future of 24 Sussex in coming weeks: sources
ca3.description: Prime minister Mark Carney is expected in the coming weeks to announce the government's decision about the future of 24 Sussex Drive, sources tell CBC News.

ca3.title: Bright fireball in Sault Ste. Marie, Ont., skies 'shocked and amazed' onlookers
ca3.description: Planetary scientists with Western University in London, Ont., say dozens of meteorites from a Friday evening fireball landed on Cockburn Island, a mostly uninhabited land mass in Lake Huron.

ca3.title: Why a 25% discount on airfare cost a Montreal couple more — thanks to dynamic pricing
ca3.description: A Montreal couple was confused and upset after they rebooked their Air Canada flight to take advantage of a new sale, and the rebooked tickets cost slightly more. ca3.title: N.L. Crown prosecutor charged with smuggling, prohibited weapon possession
ca3.description: The RCMP in eastern Newfoundland have charged a provincial Crown attorney with more than 10 charges related to smuggling, illegal importation, and weapons offences.

ca3.title: Hamilton city council approves pause on data centre development
ca3.description: City of Hamilton staff will report back to councillors at their next meeting on July 15 with a bylaw imposing a moratorium on the construction of the facilities that securely store, process and distribute digital information.

ca3.title: Feds push to have 3 northern projects fast-tracked under Building Canada Act
ca3.description: The Liberal government wants a Northwest Territories highway, an Arctic deepwater port and a nuclear waste storage facility in northwestern Ontario to be listed as projects of national interest.

ca3.title: PQ maps out its vision for an independent Quebec in Blue Book on sovereignty
ca3.description: Quebec independence would yield $13 billion to $16 billion in administrative savings by eliminating or merging most of the roughly 230 federal agencies operating in the province, Parti Québécois (PQ) Leader Paul St-Pierre Plamondon announced Tuesday.

ca3.title: Abuse alleged at N.L. preschool as parents demand answers
ca3.description: Parents of children who attended a pre-kindergarten program in eastern Newfoundland say their kids were knelt on, yelled at, and locked in a bathroom by an early childhood educator who police investigated but never charged.

ca3.title: Aurora, Ont., to remove Frank Stronach's name from recreation complex after sexual assault conviction
ca3.description: The Town of Aurora will remove Frank Stronach's name from its Aurora Recreation Complex after the 93-year-old Canadian billionaire was found guilty of one count of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault at his trial last week.

ca3.title: Orillia, Ont., to decide fate of controversial Samuel de Champlain statue
ca3.description: As the central Ontario city of Orillia decides what will happen to an imposing, century-old statue of Samuel de Champlain, it remains hidden away in storage. The city council will choose to either restore it, modify it, send it away or melt it down.

ca3.title: Does it seem easier to book a dermatologist for Botox than a mole check? You're not alone
